title: An email about your weekend
context_es: Tu amigo Jack te ha escrito para preguntarte qué tal el fin de semana. Le contestas.
prompt_en: Your friend Jack wants to know about your weekend. Write an email to Jack.
points: where you went and who you went with
tips_es: Todo lo que ya pasó va en pasado simple: *went, had, visited*.
Acaba con una pregunta para tu amigo: así el correo suena natural.
model_answer:
Hi Jack,

Thanks for your email. I had a great weekend! On Saturday I went to the mountains with my cousins. We walked for three hours and had a picnic next to a river. In the evening we played cards in a small hotel. The best thing was the view from the top, because we could see the sea.

What about you? Write soon,
Dani
